interface.signature: routes: List[List[int]], S: int, T: int -> int

preconditions.description: The number of bus routes must be between 1 and 500.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= len(route) <= 10**5 for route in routes)
preconditions.description: Each bus route must have between 1 and 100,000 stops.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= stop < 10**6 for route in routes for stop in route)
preconditions.description: Each bus stop must be a non-negative integer less than 1,000,000.

postconditions.expression: return_value == -1 if S not in any(route for route in routes) or T not in any(route for route in routes) else True
postconditions.description: If either the starting stop S or the target stop T is not present in any bus route, return -1.

postconditions.expression: return_value >= 1 if S != T else return_value == 0
postconditions.description: If S and T are different, the number of buses taken must be at least 1; if they are the same, no buses are needed.
The returned value must be the minimum number of buses required to travel from S to T.
